name: Allama
reason: Used in Karnataka after the Veerashaiva saint Allama Prabhu; meaning given was only a figure reference.

fix.meaning_en: Name honouring the Veerashaiva saint Allama Prabhu; etymology uncertain.

name: Annamayya
reason: Suitable devotional Telugu name; meaning weak and speculative.

fix.meaning_en: Telugu name honouring the saint-poet Annamacharya; etymology uncertain.

name: Bhimashankar
reason: Auspicious Jyotirlinga name; IAST lacked final a.

fix.meaning_en: Shiva as the mighty and auspicious one; also the name of a Jyotirlinga.

name: Nrupatunga
reason: Correct compound (nṛpa + tuṅga), meaning understandable, usable name.

name: Pampa
reason: place_or_river: name of the Pampa/Tungabhadra river and a poet.

name: Pullaiah
reason: Real Telugu given name; IAST was truncated and the meaning guessed.

fix.meaning_en: Traditional Telugu respectful name (Pulla + ayya); etymology uncertain.

name: Subbarao
reason: Common Telugu given name; meaning clarified.

fix.meaning_en: Subba (a Telugu form of Subrahmanya) + Rao (chief, leader); Subrahmanya the chief.

name: Venkat
reason: Meaning was wrong; it is a short form of Venkatesha/Venkateshwara.

fix.meaning_en: Short form of Venkatesha or Venkateshwara, names of Vishnu worshipped at Tirupati.

name: Venkateshwarlu
reason: Valid Telugu form; IAST truncated and meaning reworded.

fix.meaning_en: Telugu form of Venkateshwara, a name of Vishnu worshipped at Tirupati.
